statements.text: The annualized impact is expected to be between INR 100 crores to INR 125 crores annually.
It is an improvement of 7 basis points sequentially and COF is expected to be -- we had outlined at the beginning of the year from a guidance standpoint, the number to be between 7.55% to 7.65%.
We intend -- we believe that as we sharpen the model, it will take us to between 85% and 90% over a period of next 15-odd months.
We'll provide FY '27 guidance along with Q4 results, which is normally what we do every year.

All goes well in the next year based on the estimates that we have done, the number could range between INR 300 crores to INR 400 crores of additional provisioning, which will ensure that not only are we taking action in the current year, we are also continuing to take the similar action as we go along from here.
And by FY '30, we foresee we'll be doing 100 million loans a year and we would have had 200 million franchise.
And loan loss to average AR is reducing from 1.75% to 1.65% , this is really how we will report going forward as a company.
We expect that it should come back to double-digit growth or the company growth momentum between Q2 and Q3 of FY'27.

I'll also cover 2 key points, which will further reflect our confidence on credit cost outlook for next fiscal, which I'll cover in a moment, but GNPA, NNPA came in at 1.01% and NNPA came in at 41 basis points.
This will not turn green in a quarter because the denominator also has a role to play as it starts to grow by Q2 or Q3, we will start to see this turn to green.
So on the growth guidance, 22% to 24% apart from SME, which is almost bottomed out, we have started to see the sequential growth and we will get into double digits.
I think the long-term guidance that we give at this point in time is between 22% and 24%, 25% kind of corridor.
Overall, we are confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY '27 in opex to NTI.
And we, in general, remain quite optimistic about the credit cost outlook for FY '27.
On disbursements, AI, voice and text bots did INR2,500 crores, we will do INR11,000 crores INR12,000 in the full year this year.

I am targeting that next year we should be delivering INR100,000 crores volume between customer centricity, AI and tech transformation and digital transformation, all these three as they come together, that's really what we are aiming to do so that from a push business, we rapidly transition towards being a full business.
I'm looking at the denominator, which is that we will have INR630,000 crores to INR650,000 crores of balance sheet.
We've built a book of INR20,000 crores, targeting INR50,000 crores or whatever.
And we are reasonably comfortable with the credit cost outlook for FY27.

We are seized one, we have product move, we'll be proud of that moment as and when it happens, but we are also seized of the importance of resilience in our balance sheet that is needed to continue to grow from there on and get to as per last as I say INR11 lakh crores number by FY30.
I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis.
I think that's just medium term, we maintain a guidance of 20% to 25% on a year lower here and a year higher there.
So, we remain comfortable in the longer term, we should be able to sustain a 15% to 18% fee income growth is what I would just say to you, Viral.
Because at the end of the day, we intend to remain 75% holder, we today are 87% holder.
